2026-10-31UpCloudcorrectionCorrection: the $3.50 UpCloud row was labeled “Developer 1 GB”, a plan UpCloud now lists as discontinued. UpCloud Simple Backup (+20%) is now counted when backups are on. Discontinued plans are never ranked or suggested.source · 2026-10-31
2026-10-31VultrcorrectionCorrection: our verdicts, rankings and savings figures left out Vultr’s published 20% backup fee while the tables on the same pages included it. Vultr vc2-2c-4gb was shown as $20.00/mo “with backups” (and $106/yr cheaper than DigitalOcean); the true cost is $24.00/mo and the gap is $57.60/yr. Affected 19 pages. One fee policy now applies everywhere (every fee we hold is counted in tables, verdicts, rankings, widget and calculator), Vultr backup (20%) and overage ($0.01/GB) and Hetzner backup (20%) are now verified from official docs, and a build check fails if any verdict price differs from its own table.source · 2026-10-31

2026-10-31Hostinger VPScorrectionCorrection to the Black Friday VPS guide: it bolded Hostinger as lowest for each RAM size but compared it only with Vultr and DigitalOcean, leaving out cheaper no-prepay plans in our own ledger. OVHcloud VPS-1 (2 vCPU / 4 GB, $5.35/mo, no commitment, re-read 2026-10-31) costs $64.20 / $128.40 / $192.60 over 1/2/3 years vs Hostinger KVM 1 $155.76 / $155.76 / $443.52, and OVHcloud VPS-2 (4 vCPU / 8 GB, $10/mo) is lower than KVM 2 at 1 and 3 years. The guide now adds the cheapest verified, in-stock, no-prepay plan per RAM size and a build check fails if a 'lowest' label skips a cheaper row. The 3-year column assumed a 12-month renewal Hostinger doesn't show (KVM 1 $299.64); it now uses the stated same-term renewal (24 months billed up front at month 25): KVM 1 $443.52, KVM 2 $570.72, KVM 4 $1,007.52, KVM 8 $1,823.52. Sale window Oct 19 – Dec 14, 2026 added from Hostinger's Black Friday page.source · 2026-10-31
